name: Metapramine
summary: Metapramine (brand names Prodastene, Timaxel) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) developed by Rhone Poulenc that was introduced for the treatment of depression in France in 1984. In addition to its efficacy against affective disorders, it also has analgesic properties, and may be useful in the treatment of pain.

pharmacology.text: Metapramine has desipramine-like effects, acting as a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor without affecting the reuptake of serotonin or dopamine. It has also been shown to act as a low-affinity NMDA receptor antagonist.

uses.text: Metapramine (brand names Prodastene, Timaxel) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) developed by Rhone Poulenc that was introduced for the treatment of depression in France in 1984.

sideEffects.en: Little is reported about it specifically. Tricyclic antidepressants commonly cause dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, drowsiness and dizziness, and in overdose can cause dangerous heart rhythm problems and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前關於它本身的報告很少。三環抗憂鬱藥常引起口乾、便秘、視力模糊、嗜睡與頭暈，過量時可能造成危險的心律問題與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前关于它本身的报告很少。三环抗忧郁药常引起口干、便秘、视力模糊、嗜睡与头晕，过量时可能造成危险的心律问题与癫痫发作。

fact.en: Metapramine was developed by Rhône-Poulenc and launched in France in 1984. Unlike many tricyclics, it acts mainly on noradrenaline, and it has also been studied as a painkiller.
fact.zh: Metapramine 由羅納普朗克公司研發，1984年在法國上市。與許多三環類不同，它主要作用於正腎上腺素，也曾被研究作為止痛藥。
fact.zhHans: Metapramine 由罗纳普朗克公司研发，1984年在法国上市。与许多三环类不同，它主要作用于正肾上腺素，也曾被研究作为止痛药。
